label: All employees
summary: General audience spanning every function and region. Used when content applies company-wide (policies, holiday announcements, code of conduct refreshes).
toneOfVoice: Inclusive and broadly accessible. Plain language; no function-specific jargon. Address the reader directly. Default to the most cautious accessibility level.
readingContext: Mixed devices and environments — desktop in office settings, mobile on the go, kiosks on the plant floor. Assume varied reading time.
contentGuidelines: Avoid function-specific shorthand (no 'route', 'POG', 'OEE' without explanation). Reference universal portals and processes (MyPepsiCo, manager, HR). Use the highest-applicable accessibility convention in any conflict.
searchIntent: All-employees searches are broad and process-oriented ("how do I…", "where do I…"). They tend to land on overview/topic pages and click through. Optimize for clarity over depth.
